▪️With zero crosses and religious symbols
▪️Zero presence is allowed in public domain- including in advertising

🔵 Qatar has a few hundred thousands of Christian non-citizens working there to support families back home. Sometimes in a modern slavery status. They are the laborers, the service workers, the housekeepers. They are doing the dirty work of building this gas-rich nation. 

No other religion is permitted, not Hindu or Judaism. 

Father Rally: “It is a way for us to respect the country because they have given us a place of worship,” “There are Muslim traditions, and we have to adapt,” Father Rally said. “Friday is our Sunday.”

Catholic leadership in Vatican City, he said, grants special permission to Our Lady of the Rosary to conduct Sunday’s liturgy two days early.

https://t.co/R7gAWmasTc

🔵 In Israel: There are hundreds of churches in Israel - practicing freely, on Sunday and with large crosses on them, about 200,000 Christians - 180,000 of them are Arab citizens and the rest are temporary working force. In Qatar they can stay forever as non citizens with minimal rights if any at all. 

🔵 ☪️ There are about 360,000 Muslim citizens in Qatar (only Muslims are allowed to be Muslims) and 1.8 million (!) Muslim citizens in Israel today - with full and equal rights. As @TuckerCarlson would say: if it’s so bad for them… why are there so many? 

Israel is a Jewish sovereignty, and I think it should enforce rules in the public domain as well - to prevent missionary, but in churches there should be a proud and free celebration of your religion. 

I wish I could say the same about practicing Islam but I see it as a political agenda and not a personal faith- and I think there should be much stricter rules about practicing it in Israel - it has 100% in Israel today, and the incitement and public dominance is very high.
